historical_commentary.text: This note explains how 4D of that era handled foreign-language systems specifically under Windows NT. Windows NT itself has been obsolete for decades (superseded by subsequent Windows releases and ultimately Windows 10/11), and 4D's Unicode and localization support has been completely overhauled since (full Unicode text handling was introduced around 4D v11 SQL), making both the OS context and the specific localization techniques described purely of historical interest today.
related_updates: 4D introduced full native Unicode text support around 4D v11 SQL (~2007), superseding the older code-page/localization approach
Windows NT is long obsolete, superseded by many subsequent Windows releases
